2608.18709.title: A Critical Synthesis of Uncertainty Quantification and Foundation Models for Semantic Segmentation
2608.18709.paper_summary: Foundation models are increasingly breaking what seemed to be impossible not long ago by enabling unprecedented accuracy and cross-domain generalization. Yet their lack of interpretability, tendency to be overconfident, and sensitivity to real-world domain shifts pose critical challenges for safety- and mission-critical applications. Uncertainty quantification (UQ) offers a principled way to address these issues, but its integration into segmentation foundation models has yet to be explored. In this paper we present the first systematic evaluation of UQ methods applied to a foundation model for semantic segmentation. We fine-tune a lightweight DPT decoder on top of the pretrained SAM2 encoder to establish a simple yet competitive baseline and benchmark four representative UQ approaches - Monte Carlo Dropout, Deep Sub-Ensemble, Test-Time Augmentation, and Evidential Deep Learning - across Cityscapes, NYUv2, and two challenging out-of-domain settings. Our analysis compares segmentation accuracy, calibration, uncertainty quality, and inference time, revealing clear trade-offs between predictive performance, reliability, and computational cost. These results highlight both the promise and the current limitations of uncertainty-aware foundation models, pointing to the need for future work that jointly optimizes accuracy, robustness, and efficiency for real-world deployment.
2608.18709.paper_summary_zh: 基礎模型正逐漸打破不久前看似不可能的界限，實現前所未有的準確性和跨領域泛化。<lb/>然而，它們缺乏可解釋性、過度自信的傾向以及對現實世界領域變化的敏感性，對於安全和任務關鍵的應用構成了重大挑戰。<lb/>不確定性量化（UQ）提供了一種原則性的方法來解決這些問題，但其在分割基礎模型中的整合尚待探索。<lb/>在本文中，我們首次系統性評估了應用於語義分割的基礎模型的UQ方法。<lb/>我們在預訓練的SAM2編碼器之上微調了一個輕量級的DPT解碼器，以建立一個簡單但具有競爭力的基準，並在Cityscapes、NYUv2及兩個具有挑戰性的跨域設定中基準四種代表性的UQ方法——蒙特卡洛隨機失活、深度子集成、測試時增強和證據深度學習。<lb/>我們的分析比較了分割準確性、校準、不確定性質量和推理時間，揭示了預測性能、可靠性和計算成本之間的明顯權衡。<lb/>這些結果突顯了不確定性感知基礎模型的潛力及當前限制，指出了未來需要共同優化準確性、穩健性和效率以實現現實世界部署的工作需求。
